fusions.name: Heavy Calibre
fusions.desc: Fires a heavy round at an enemy up to 7 tiles away that deals 36 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mauling Buckshot
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of buckshot 4 tiles ahead that deals 14 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Stock
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and your armour rises by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Trophy Hide
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
